self.zh: 放在「我」这个位置，它描述的是你自己带进这段关系里的状态，而不是对方造成的。
self.en: In the Self position, this describes what you are bringing into the situation rather than what was done to you.

other.zh: 放在「对方」这个位置，它描述的是对方的处境和动机——未必是对方对你的态度。
other.en: In the Other position, this describes their situation and motives — which is not the same as their feelings toward you.

relationship.zh: 放在「关系」这个位置，它描述的是你们之间那个共同体本身，不属于任何一方。
relationship.en: In the Relationship position, this describes the thing the two of you make together — which belongs to neither of you alone.

situation.zh: 放在「现状」这个位置，它描述的是事情此刻实际的样子，不含判断。
situation.en: In the Situation position, this describes how things actually stand right now, without a verdict attached.

challenge.zh: 放在「挑战」这个位置，它指出的是需要被正视的那个阻力——即使这张牌本身是正面的。
challenge.en: In the Challenge position, this names the resistance that has to be faced — even when the card itself reads positively.

advice.zh: 放在「建议」这个位置，它要被当作行动方向来读：这张牌在描述你可以采取的姿态。
advice.en: In the Advice position, read this as a direction to move in: it describes a stance available to you.

current.zh: 放在「现状」这个位置，它描述的是当前的实际条件，包括你手上已经有的资源。
current.en: In the Current position, this describes the actual conditions you're working with, including what you already have.

opportunity.zh: 放在「机遇」这个位置，它指向的是尚未被充分利用的那一面，而不是已经发生的事。
opportunity.en: In the Opportunity position, this points at what hasn't been used yet rather than at what has already happened.

past.zh: 放在「过去」这个位置，它描述的是已经完成、但仍在影响现在的东西。
past.en: In the Past position, this describes something already finished that is still shaping the present.

present.zh: 放在「现在」这个位置，它描述的是此刻正在起作用的力量，还没有定型。
present.en: In the Present position, this describes the force currently at work — still in motion, not yet settled.

future.zh: 放在「未来」这个位置，它描述的是照当前趋势会走向的方向，不是注定的结局。
future.en: In the Future position, this describes where the current trajectory leads — a direction, not a verdict.

influence.zh: 放在「影响」这个位置，它指出的是推动或阻碍这件事的力量，可能来自外部，也可能来自你自己。
influence.en: In the Influence position, this names what is pushing this along or holding it back — which may be external or may be you.

guidance.zh: 放在「指引」这个位置，它要被当作可执行的方向来读，而不是预测。
guidance.en: In the Guidance position, read this as something actionable rather than as a prediction.
